events.name: ConfigChange
events.when: When a configuration file changes during a session

events.name: CwdChanged
events.when: When the working directory changes, for example when Claude executes a `cd` command. Useful for reactive environment management with tools like direnv

events.name: Elicitation
events.when: When an MCP server requests user input during a tool call

events.name: ElicitationResult
events.when: After a user responds to an MCP elicitation, before the response is sent back to the server

events.name: FileChanged
events.when: When a watched file changes on disk. The `matcher` field specifies which filenames to watch

events.name: InstructionsLoaded
events.when: When a CLAUDE.md or `.claude/rules/*.md` file is loaded into context. Fires at session start and when files are lazily loaded during a session

events.name: Notification
events.when: When Claude Code sends a notification

events.name: PermissionDenied
events.when: When a tool call is denied by the auto mode classifier. Return `{retry: true}` to tell the model it may retry the denied tool call

events.name: PermissionRequest
events.when: When a permission dialog appears

events.name: PostCompact
events.when: After context compaction completes

events.name: PostToolBatch
events.when: After a full batch of parallel tool calls resolves, before the next model call

events.name: PostToolUse
events.when: After a tool call succeeds

events.name: PostToolUseFailure
events.when: After a tool call fails

events.name: PreCompact
events.when: Before context compaction

events.name: PreToolUse
events.when: Before a tool call executes. Can block it

events.name: SessionEnd
events.when: When a session terminates

events.name: SessionStart
events.when: When a session begins or resumes

events.name: Setup
events.when: When you start Claude Code with `--init-only`, or with `--init` or `--maintenance` in `-p` mode. For one-time preparation in CI or scripts

events.name: Stop
events.when: When Claude finishes responding

events.name: StopFailure
events.when: When the turn ends due to an API error. Output and exit code are ignored

events.name: SubagentStart
events.when: When a subagent is spawned

events.name: SubagentStop
events.when: When a subagent finishes

events.name: TaskCompleted
events.when: When a task is being marked as completed

events.name: TaskCreated
events.when: When a task is being created via `TaskCreate`

events.name: TeammateIdle
events.when: When an [agent team](/en/agent-teams) teammate is about to go idle

events.name: UserPromptExpansion
events.when: When a user-typed command expands into a prompt, before it reaches Claude. Can block the expansion

events.name: UserPromptSubmit
events.when: When you submit a prompt, before Claude processes it

events.name: WorktreeCreate
events.when: When a worktree is being created via `--worktree` or `isolation: "worktree"`. Replaces default git behavior

events.name: WorktreeRemove
events.when: When a worktree is being removed, either at session exit or when a subagent finishes
